description: More failure texts for the shared errors core (phase 6): classes the first set did not reach, and texts only the Android build used to recognise (platforms: android, so the desktop keeps its behaviour). Wording is never compared; every case also fails if the user-facing message names an external tool.

cases.name: a live stream recording that is gone

input.text: ERROR: [youtube] abc: This live stream recording is not available.
ERROR: [youtube] abc: Unable to download webpage: [SSL: UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING] EOF occurred in violation of protocol

cases.name: a locked browser cookie database
cases.reason: Only the desktop reads cookies from installed browsers.

cases.name: the player response could not be read

input.text: ERROR: [youtube] abc: Failed to extract any player response; please report this issue

cases.name: a restricted song marker added by the app (music)
cases.reason: Only the Android app adds this marker after confirming a regional restriction.

cases.name: a restricted video marker added by the app (other)
cases.reason: Only the Android app adds this marker after confirming a regional restriction.

cases.name: the page needs to be reloaded (android)
cases.reason: The desktop words this unclassified and refreshes the engine instead.

input.text: ERROR: [youtube] abc: The page needs to be reloaded.

cases.name: a record layer failure (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build recognised this connection failure.

input.text:
WARNING: [youtube] [SSL] record layer failure
ERROR: [youtube] abc: Unable to download webpage

cases.name: http 410 gone (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build recognised 410 as removed.

input.text: ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 410: Gone

cases.name: taken down (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build recognised this removal wording.

input.text: ERROR: This video has been taken down

cases.name: registered users only (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build recognised this login wall.

input.text: ERROR: This video is only available for registered users

cases.name: incompatible formats (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build recognised this format failure.

input.text: ERROR: Requested formats are incompatible for merge

cases.name: a broken pipe (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build treated this as a connection hiccup.

cases.name: operation not permitted (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build mapped this to a storage permission failure.

cases.name: the API page could not be downloaded (android)
cases.reason: Android reads this as a refused download and refreshes its bundled engine.

input.text: ERROR: [youtube] abc: Unable to download API page

cases.name: a live event not started, written as an upcoming flag (android)
cases.reason: Only the Android build recognised this wording.

input.text: ERROR: [youtube] abc: is_upcoming: this stream has not started
